name: PowOS emulator lane (Mac)
purpose: the emulator lane for window and app checks that don't need the phone's hardware: an arm64 Android 16 AVD (powos-open) shaped like the OnePlus Open's inner screen (2268x2440, 442 dpi), headless from its powos-ready snapshot, PowOS installed as a privileged system app the way the phone's system module does it, plus the test window client. Checks reach it with POWOS_DEVICE=emu (tools/phone/adb.sh); queue.sh add --dev emu runs them at once (its runner: queue.sh run-emu, own checkout .claude/worktrees/emu-runner). Builds go through the warm builder with PUBLISH=0 (never into android-app-dev/output, which PowApps serves). Disk: data partition 6 GB (written whole: the AVD is ~9.4 GB, ~13.7 GB with the image); emu.sh refuses to create or start below 25 GB free on the Mac (EMU_MIN_FREE_GB)
installedBy: tools/emu/emu.sh create (once); emu.sh start / queue.sh add --dev emu (on demand)

limits.memory: 4096m (hw.ramSize; the emulator raises less to 4096 for this screen)
